implementation.name: original-v4-08-rolling-shutter-rows
implementation.scope: Canonical navigation-camera plot and its RollingShutterSkew LEGO inputs. A cursor samples rows; playback duration does not represent acquisition time.
implementation.question: How does row timing differ from exposure blur?

purpose: Follow each row’s changing sample position while keeping its separate exposure-width blur visible.
guard: Preserve original axes, band and allowance. Row readout skew is distinct from exposure blur; do not add the two as if they were independent measured errors.
